section: Tarea 2 -> Descarga automatizada de genomas desde NCBI
text:
Tarea 2 -> Descarga automatizada de genomas desde NCBI
OBJETIVOS:

T2.1 Definir los criterios de filtrado de genomas
T2.2 Desarrollar un script de descarga reproducible y automatizada con NCBI Datasets, adaptado a los criterios definidos

Guía para usar datasets






ImportantFlags que puede tener el comando datasets





–annotated Limit to annotated genomes
–assembly-level string Limit to genomes at one or more assembly levels (comma-separated): * chromosome * complete * contig * scaffold (default “[]”)
–assembly-source string Limit to ‘RefSeq’ (GCF_) or ‘GenBank’ (GCA_) genomes (default “all”)
–assembly-version string Optionally return “all” assembly accession versions * all: current assembly versions + all previous versions * current: current assembly versions, plus previous versions only if paired with a current version (default)
–chromosomes strings Limit to a specified, comma-delimited list of chromosomes, or ‘all’ for all chromosomes
–dehydrated Download a dehydrated zip archive including the data report and locations of data files (use the rehydrate command to retrieve data files).
–exclude-atypical Exclude atypical assemblies
–exclude-multi-isolate Exclude assemblies from multi-isolate projects –fast-zip-validation Skip zip checksum validation after download
–from-type Only return records with type material
–include string(,string) Specify the data files to include (comma-separated). * genome: genomic sequence * rna: transcript * protein: amino acid sequences * cds: nucleotide coding sequences * gff3: general feature file * gtf: gene transfer format * gbff: GenBank flat file * seq-report: sequence report file * all: include all available file types (equivalent to genome,protein,cds,gff3,gtf,gbff,rna,seq-report) * none: do not retrieve any sequence files (default [genome])
–mag string Limit to metagenome assembled genomes (only) or remove them from the results (exclude) (default “all”)
–preview Show information about the requested data package
–reference Limit to reference genomes
–released-after string Limit to genomes released on or after a specified date (free format, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD recommended)
–released-before string Limit to genomes released on or before a specified date (free format, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD recommended)
–search strings Limit results to genomes with specified text in the searchable fields: species and infraspecies, assembly name and submitter. To search multiple strings, use the flag multiple times.

IntegronFinder2 si tenemos mcuhos genomas va a tardar mucho, así que pongo opción con flag modificable para hacer un filtrado previo con integron-filtering

INTEGRON-FILTERING
En integron-filtering hay dos posibles scripts de filtrado:

attC-screening.sh (HattCI + Infernal): No hace predicción génica ni hmmsearch, busca la secuencia/estructura secundaria del attC directamente sobre la secuencia de ADN.
IntI-screening.sh (Prodigal + hmmsearch del dominio IntI): se solapa con lo que ya hace IntegronFinder2 internamente.

FIXME : por ahora solo voy a usar integron-filtering el script de attC-screening.sh






ImportantArgumentos que acepta el script attC-screening.sh





attC-screening.sh usage: usage: ./attC-screening.sh
Mandatory arguments:

-m : universal attC CM (‘attCs.cm’)

El attC no se reconoce por una secuencia, sino por su estructura secundaria conservada. Se usará el dado en el propio repositorio de github, que está entrenado para reconocer attC de forma genérica (universal)

-i : input fasta of DNA sequences

Optional arguments: he dejado las opciones por default con opción a ser modificables MENOS los CPUs

-b : bit score cut-off for cmsearch | default: 20

A mayor cut-off, mayor debe ser el parecido

-l : minimum length of output sequences | default: 500 bp

Longitud mínima que debe tener la secuencia para ser válida (descarta fragmentos demasiado cortos)

-t : number of CPUs | default: 1

Número de CPUs, el default es 1 pero lo he cambiado a los máximos de la máquina -1

-o : output directory | default: current directory

Carpeta donde se guardan los resultados




Output de integron-filtering
Lo que hace es analizar el genoma pasado (ej. genoma con chr1 + plásmido1 + plásmido2… -> archivo multifasta) y genera varios archivos. El que interesa es el que acaba en attC_filtered.fasta, que mantiene el contexto entero (ej. chr1 entero) de aquellos accession en los que ha encontrado coincidencia con sitio attC. Nos interesa mantener el contexto para luego estudiar bien el promotor con IntegronFinder2
FIXME: Se podría cambiar el funcionamiento si no da buenos resultados, ya que este programa genera otros archivos donde concreta mucho más el sitio attC ¿Igual por requerimientos de tiempo?

title: Semana del 14 al 18 de Septiembre
text:
IntegronFinder2
IntegronFinder2 identifica integrones en secuencias de DNA y acota las regiones de los Pc (que es lo que nos interesa) en los integrones encontrados
Uso del comando en bash:
integron_finder [-h] [--local-max] [--func-annot] [--cpu CPU] [-dt DISTANCE_THRESHOLD] 
                [--outdir OUTDIR] [--union-integrases] [--cmsearch CMSEARCH] 
                [--hmmsearch HMMSEARCH] [--prodigal PRODIGAL] [--path-func-annot PATH_FUNC_ANNOT] 
                [--gembase] [--gembase-path GEMBASE_PATH] [--annot-parser ANNOT_PARSER] 
                [--prot-file PROT_FILE] [--attc-model ATTC_MODEL] [--evalue-attc EVALUE_ATTC] 
                [--calin-threshold CALIN_THRESHOLD] [--keep-palindromes] [--no-proteins]
                [--promoter-attI] [--max-attc-size MAX_ATTC_SIZE] [--min-attc-size MIN_ATTC_SIZE] 
                [--eagle-eyes] [--pdf] [--gbk] [--keep-tmp] [--split-results] [--circ | --linear] 
                [--topology-file TOPOLOGY_FILE] [--version] [--mute] [-v] [-q] replicon






ImportantArgumentos que acepta IntegronFinder2





He marcado en azul aquellos argumentos que pueden tener sentido para la búsqueda y clasificación de Pcs:
positional arguments:

replicon: Path to the replicon file (in fasta format), eg : path/to/file.fst or file.fst

optional arguments:

-h, –help: show this help message and exit
–local-max: Allows thorough local detection (slower but more sensitive and do not increase false positive rate).
–func-annot: Functional annotation of CDS associated with integrons HMM files are needed in Func_annot folder.
–cpu CPU: Number of CPUs used by INFERNAL and HMMER. Increasing too much (usually above 4) may decrease performance.
-dt DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, –distance-thresh DISTANCE_THRESHOLD: Two elements are aggregated if they are distant of DISTANCE_THRESH [4000]bp or less
–outdir OUTDIR: Set the output directory (default: current)
–union-integrases: Instead of taking intersection of hits from Phage_int profile (Tyr recombinases) and integron_integrase profile, use the union of the hits. Es decir, IntegronFinder no detecta la Int con un solo modelo, sino combinando dos perfiles HMM distintos, luego se mantiene la intersección de ambos modelos para ser detectado

De estos siguientes no hay que modificar nada porque hemos instalado el entorno completo:

–cmsearch CMSEARCH: Complete path to cmsearch if not in PATH. eg: /usr/local/bin/cmsearch
–hmmsearch HMMSEARCH: Complete path to hmmsearch if not in PATH. eg: /usr/local/bin/hmmsearch
–prodigal PRODIGAL: Complete path to prodigal if not in PATH. eg: /usr/local/bin/prodigal
–path-func-annot PATH_FUNC_ANNOT: Path to file containing all hmm bank paths (one per line)

Los siguientes son alternativas para no usar PRODIGAL y usar otro fichero de proteínas ya anotado:

–gembase: Use gembase formatted protein file instead of Prodigal. Folder structure must be preserved
–gembase-path GEMBASE_PATH: path to the gembase root directory (needed only if the replicon file is not locatedin gembase-path)
–annot-parser ANNOT_PARSER: the path to the parser to use to get information from protein file.
–prot-file PROT_FILE: The path to the proteins file used for annotations
–attc-model ATTC_MODEL: Path or file to the attc model (Covariance Matrix).
–evalue-attc EVALUE_ATTC: Set evalue threshold to filter out hits above it (default: 1) Un valor más bajo es más estricto (ahora es E-value)
–calin-threshold CALIN_THRESHOLD: keep ‘CALIN’ only if attC sites number >= calin-threshold (default: 2) Un CALIN es un cluster de sitios attC que aparecen juntos sin una Int cercana asociada. El default exige que haya al menos 2 attC juntos para que sea CALIN
–keep-palindromes: For a given hit, if the palindromic version is found, don’t remove the one with highest evalue. Los attC son repeticiones invertidas imperfectas, así que a veces se encuentran hits prácticamente en la misma posición en ambas hebras. Por defecto, se queda solo con el mejor de los dos (menor e-value)
–no-proteins: Don’t annotate CDS and don’t find integrase, just look for attC sites. No debemos usarlo porque anota el pc en relación a la posición de la Integrasas
–promoter-attI: Search also for promoter and attI sites. (default False)
–max-attc-size MAX_ATTC_SIZE: Set maximum value fot the attC size (default: 200bp)
–min-attc-size MIN_ATTC_SIZE: Set minimum value fot the attC size (default: 40bp)
**–eagle-eyes: Synonym of –local-max. Like a soaring eagle in the sky, catching rabbits (or attC sites) by surprise.

### FIXME: Igual hay que modificar estos argumentos (topology file), porque: como en la T2 controlamos el nivel de ensamblado (complete/chromosome/scaffold/contig) al descargar los genomas, podemos generar el –topology-file con criterio correcto luego habría que añadir esta parte!!!

–circ: Set the default topology for replicons to ‘circular’
–linear: Set the default topology for replicons to ‘linear’
–topology-file TOPOLOGY_FILE: The path to a file where the topology for each replicon is specified.
–version: show program’s version number and exit
–mute: mute the log on stdout.(continue to log on integron_finder.out)

Output options:

–pdf: For each complete integron, a simple graphic of the region is depicted (in pdf format)
–gbk: generate a GenBank file with the sequence annotated with the same annotations than .integrons file.
–keep-tmp: keep intermediate results. This results are stored in directory named tmp_
–split-results: Instead of merging integron results from all replicon in one file, keep them in separated files.
-v, –verbose: Increase verbosity of output (can be cumulative : -vv)
-q, –quiet: Decrease verbosity of output (can be cumulative : -qq)




Es decir, el nuevo uso del comando quedaría como:
integron_finder [--local-max] [--cpu CPU] [-dt DISTANCE_THRESHOLD] [--outdir OUTDIR] 
                [--attc-model ATTC_MODEL] [--evalue-attc EVALUE_ATTC] 
                [--keep-palindromes] --promoter-attI [--max-attc-size MAX_ATTC_SIZE] 
                [--min-attc-size MIN_ATTC_SIZE] [--eagle-eyes] --gbk 
                [--topology-file TOPOLOGY_FILE] replicon
